# seed-artifact

Artifact-folder identity per Decision #16 nested layout. The folder IS the
artifact; `seed-artifact.md` is the content. ROOM.md exists to satisfy the
Phase 87-01a pre-commit guard which requires ROOM.md + MINTO.md in every
directory under a `.room-root` subtree.
